The Library Aesthetic Dance Media is a unique, niche collaborative streaming platform dedicated to dancer wellbeing, inspiration, fitness, and health. ​ ​

Bloch is proud to be a Major Aligning Brand partner of The Library Aesthetic, delivering accessible, inspiring, and credible dance health content to dancers everywhere!​

The platform brings together globally respected individuals, organisations, syllabus, and brands with the aim to develop a better conversation and awareness of dancer health.​
